title: lygodium scandens
intro: Lygodium scandens, commonly known as climbing fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Lygodiaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include the treatment of various gastrointestinal issues such as constipation and diarrhea due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Lygodium scandens include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lygodium scandens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
